findings.rationale: The bucket carries a public-read ACL, so every object in demo-public-bucket is readable by unauthenticated parties and the bucket is effectively internet-reachable storage.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf, aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket, acl attribute set to public-read

findings.control: storage exposure: account-level public guard absent
findings.rationale: The file defines no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource, so nothing at the account or bucket level overrides or contains the planted public ACL.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf, absent aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource (the file plants the absence)

findings.control: data protection: encryption at rest absent
findings.rationale: The bucket defines no server-side encryption configuration, so objects persist unencrypted and the exposure compounds from readable to readable-and-plaintext.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf, absent server-side encryption configuration for aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket (the file plants the absence)
